widths.note: 39' from Dunlap east to Elm; the part from Branch to Dunlap is 25'
the unnamed street from the north end of Branch Street NE to Stark Street

bends.note: Central Av. turns from about 25 deg off vertical (north) to about 10 deg (south)
Dunlap runs straight N-S below here and leans NE (about 17 deg) up to McMicken
Branch runs SSE (about 18 deg off vertical) from its north end to here, then due south to Henry

notes: Central Avenue runs down the west edge; the strip west of it (x < ~290) is the margin of sheet 217, so Dayton Alley, Dayton, Linnaeus and York are T junctions here (the east side of Central is closed at each); Charlotte and Findlay cross. Charlotte jogs ~28 px and Findlay ~55 px at Central (east parts lower); points are the midpoints. Henry Street jogs ~40 px at Dunlap (west part is 25 ft, lower); point is the midpoint. The 30 ft street from the top of Branch Street NE to Stark Street has no name printed here (written as '?'); it may be part of Branch Street, since the water pipe runs through without a break. At the north end of Branch an unnamed ~15 ft alley comes in from the NW and runs into the blank area of sheet 229 (recorded in alleys; the drawn end is not a real end). North Elm Street (named on sheet 219, 'N. ELM') leaves McMicken to the NNE ~200 px west of where Elm meets McMicken (two T points). The street leaving Elm to the east at y~4194 (name not printed here) is Henry Street on sheet 219; it does not line up with the Henry Street west of Elm on this sheet (~535 px further south), so Henry jogs ~90 ft at Elm and both points are T. Forbus is printed 'FORBUS' west of Dunlap and 'ALLEY' east of Dunlap, read as one alley (Forbus Alley), 12 ft both sides. W. Plum Street is the ~18-23 ft strip along the west bank of the Miami Canal, E. Plum Street the ~13-23 ft strip along the east bank; the canal itself is ignored. Logan Street and Providence Street enter from the south and stop at Findlay. Stark Street continues NW past the 30 ft street into the sheet-229 blank area (no further junctions drawn).
